notes.title: Edge Of Dead Update.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39080478/32b5c669c4491c35b1e81222b4e911a0bc993b66.png[/img]
[h2]Progress[/h2]
Edge Of Dead is progressing nicely. With all of the core mechanics finished work now is focused on finishing the remaining content, squashing bugs, and balancing game play. No final release date has been determined but it’s close. The prologue may get some attention before then too. Look here for weekly updates.

[h2]More Pixels[/h2]
Artwork in the orbiting freighter level has been reworked. Added these cryogenic chambers. I wonder what or who is in them?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39080478/adf034113433fce93f19491ef9e54dee81d6ff58.gif[/img]

[h2]Hazards[/h2]
Hazards in the industrial area include an out of control lightning tower. After much thought it was decided that the player should be able to destroy environmental hazards like this but not easily.

Smashing stuff was added recently. Each area now has it's own type of unique destructable clutter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39080478/2f5ec8d3a35a2f6282e2be5a014a05dcfcb60022.gif[/img]

[h2]Check out the prologue[/h2]
Have you always wanted to fight bone spiders, robots and a walking cactus at the same time? Now you can in the Edge Of Dead Prologue. It's available now. Get it here.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2484450?utm_source=EdgeOfDeadNew

notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.content:
This update includes gamepad support and the ability to remap controls. There is also a new inventory management system and map screen to make teleporting around and examining your loot easier. The update also includes numerous bug fixes.

Hope you enjoy the demo and feel free to leave feedback.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39080478/29d4e29c1811d2df92f5ea8855aeacf1a1e8110b.gif[/img]
